correctness.rationale: For each n, direct existential accessibility gives Diamond(X) as intersection with the union of base atoms in X. An induction using opposite-minimum-parity suffix classes defines each singleton world {k}; its Diamond image defines the coordinate k. All world-singletons and hence all propositions are Boolean combinations. Constants alone cannot generate beyond two values; atom counts give n pure Boolean generators. Verified by a standalone independent interpretation through n=11 and separate partition refinement through n=8. No infinite theorem relies on finite testing alone.

value.rationale: The exact and sharp modal generating rank is one for every n≥2 despite 2^n−1 worlds and pure-Boolean generating rank n. It is a natural complete classification of one-variable expressive power for the full finite Boolean compatibility frames arising from a 2026 modal-forcing setting; the explicit singleton definitions provide reusable formulas and a structural explanation rather than just a small-case census.
